title: Release research-v1
acceptance: Owner tags the release that ships research-v1 after green CI on main (one tag may ship several packs)
CHANGELOG names the new cases; consumers adopt through their pin
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Tag pushed by the owner; consumers see the new cases as pending
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-26 after the owner accepted the proposal on its decision page, at observed agent speed for one-PR pack steps. Not a measurement.
